research_question: Can repeated agent-generated changes remain locally acceptable under ordinary validation while cumulatively degrading prospectively defined structural invariants?

repository.rationale: It is the only candidate repository present in /workspace and provides executable Python build/validation entry points with tests and documented independent helper roles.

t0_structure.method: Python ast import extraction; count only imports whose module begins scripts, tests, or tools

invariants.statement: Production scripts must not depend on tests.
basis: scripts/README.md describes scripts as repository helper entry points
tests import or execute scripts, establishing the existing direction tests -> scripts
T0 AST graph has no scripts -> tests edge
invariants.limitation: AST imports only; subprocesses, file reads, and dynamic imports are not dependency edges unless separately recorded.
invariants.measurement: Count scripts/*.py imports beginning tests; zero required.

invariants.statement: A build entry-point module must not import another build entry-point module.
basis: scripts/README.md describes build helpers as distinct helper scripts
README.md documents build_papers.py as an independently invoked entry point
T0 AST graph has no scripts.build_* -> scripts.build_* edges
invariants.limitation: Shared non-entry-point helpers are allowed; semantic responsibility cohesion is NOT_MEASURABLE.
invariants.measurement: Count AST imports between scripts/build*.py modules; zero required.

invariants.statement: Repository validation must remain read-only with respect to tracked files.
basis: T0 ordinary validation leaves the tracked tree clean
invariants.limitation: Only tracked-tree mutation is measurable; external side effects are NOT_MEASURABLE.
invariants.measurement: git status --porcelain after validation must be empty.

objectives.objective: Add a small reusable canonical JSON writer and use it in scripts/build_analysis.py, preserving CLI behavior and output format.
Adopt the canonical JSON writer in scripts/build_dataset.py, preserving CLI behavior and output format.
Adopt the canonical JSON writer in scripts/build_publication_manifest.py, preserving CLI behavior and output format.

agent.context: At each transition: resulting prior state, frozen objective, repository instructions, and ordinary validation feedback. The agent is not shown structural results or invariant assessments until its candidate is accepted/rejected.

ordinary_validation.acceptance: Exit 0 and objective-specific tests added or updated where needed; reject candidate otherwise. One repair attempt permitted and preserved.

structural_measurements: AST internal import edges per transition
not_measurable: runtime coupling not expressed as Python imports
stopping_rule: Stop after T3; or record EXPERIMENT_BLOCKED if a transition cannot produce an ordinarily valid candidate after one preserved repair attempt or tooling cannot execute. Do not add objectives.

determination_rule.AGENTIC_STRUCTURAL_DRIFT_SUPPORTED: At least two ordinarily accepted transitions collectively create a material violation of INV-1, INV-2, or INV-3 that is absent at T0 and not identified by ordinary validation.
determination_rule.AGENTIC_STRUCTURAL_DRIFT_NOT_SUPPORTED: All executable transitions are ordinarily accepted and T0-to-T3 shows no material frozen-invariant degradation.
determination_rule.AGENTIC_STRUCTURAL_DRIFT_INDETERMINATE: Execution completes but measurement ambiguity/noise or mixed acceptance prevents either supported or not-supported determination.

separations: Locally valid change != globally coherent transition
